links.outcome: Recognition and communication of risk in high-risk hemorrhoid scenarios (alarm symptoms, bleeding, acute pain)
links.effect: No model gave harmful recommendations or guidance likely to cause substantial diagnostic delay; DeepSeek showed disproportionately urgent or alarmist language in some higher-risk scenarios; model divergence larger in clinically significant scenarios.
links.quote: No model generated directly harmful medical recommendations or explicit guidance likely to result in substantial diagnostic delay.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the safety, accuracy, and communication style of three LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek) answering hemorrhoid-related patient questions in a simulated benchmark/offline expert-review setup without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
